visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a navy blue 'MAN CONTROL' hoodie stands in an office hallway next to a man in a black baseball cap and a white/black jacket. She demonstrates a hand game, pointing to each finger sequentially while smiling broadly. The background features a wooden staircase and glass partitions. (2) The scene cuts to another woman in a tan vest and black turtleneck performing the same hand game in an open-plan office. Desks with monitors, computer equipment, and boxes of 'COMMA' snacks and Coca-Cola are visible behind her. (3) Several women are gathered around an office desk, reacting with laughter and confusion. One woman in a grey sweater sits at the table, watching the demonstration intently. (4) The woman in the blue hoodie repeats the game, holding her hand up close to the camera, her fingers splayed as she points to them one by one. The man in the cap stands beside her, clapping rhythmically. (5) A montage follows showing various individuals attempting the challenge: a woman in a yellow cardigan, a woman in a black leather jacket, and the woman in the grey sweater. They all mimic the hand movements but display varying levels of success and confusion. (6) A technical glitch screen with SMPTE color bars appears briefly with text, indicating a pause in the action. (7) The secret of the game is revealed as the man in the cap performs the sequence slowly, ending with a specific arm-crossing gesture. The others react with 'aha' moments and laughter. (8) The video concludes with the group standing together in the office, smiling and waving towards the camera, encouraging the audience to join the challenge.
